title: Surreal Celestial Tower
description: A circular surreal painting depicts a tall ornate clock tower emerging from a green landscape and piercing a large teal planet in the center of a cosmic scene. Colorful spheres, butterflies, and bats orbit the planet against a gradient teal and beige background.
prompt: A surreal circular painting featuring a tall ornate clock tower rising from a detailed green landscape with hills and ruins, the tower piercing through the center of a large teal planet. Colorful spheres in orange, pink, yellow and blue orbit around it along with monarch butterflies and bats, all set against a dreamy teal cosmic sky that gradients into beige, in a detailed illustrative fantasy style.
